name: Do energy-efficient windows require special maintenance?

mainEntity.name: Do energy-efficient windows require special maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, energy-efficient windows do not require special maintenance beyond what is typical for any high-quality window. Routine cleaning of the glass and frames with mild soap and water is usually sufficient. It's also a good practice to periodically check weatherstripping and seals for any signs of wear or damage to ensure they continue to perform optimally. Most modern energy-efficient windows, particularly those with vinyl or fiberglass frames, are designed for durability and low maintenance, ensuring long-lasting performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, energy-efficient windows typically require only routine cleaning of glass and frames, and occasional checks of seals, similar to other high-quality windows.
